summary.one_liner: A video tutorial (part 1) on starting a Flutter food-delivery e-commerce app with a backend, covering starter code, the main food page, layout widgets, icons, and the Stack widget.
keywords: how to build a shopping app in flutter
flutter food ordering app with backend
takeaways: Sets up starter code for a Flutter food-delivery shopping app that targets both iOS and Android.
Builds the main food page UI using Flutter layout basics such as columns and main-axis alignment.
Introduces widgets, icons, and a page builder for displaying content.
Shows how to use the Stack widget and a Stack-plus-Container solution for overlapping layouts.
The video introduces an app backend; the page does not detail its implementation in the visible text.
summary.summary: This is part 1 of a YouTube crash-course tutorial by dbestech that builds a food-delivery e-commerce app in Flutter with a backend, for iOS and Android. The chapter list shows the flow: starter code, building the main food page, a brief look at the app backend, layout concepts (main-axis alignment, columns), widgets, icons, a page builder, and the Stack widget with a Stack-container solution. The page text is mostly the YouTube chapter and transcript UI, so the detailed backend implementation and code are not visible here.
